'''Urdosh''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan that was led and represented on the [[Three Families]] by [[Jeelta Urdosh]] on [[Quesh]].

==Behind the scenes==
The existence of the Urdosh clan is implied by [[Jeelta Urdosh|Jeelta's]] [[Cuirvas|cuivras]], of which identifies a Hutt's clan.
